gloss: fierce match; heated contest; close game; exciting battle

definitions.gloss: fierce match; heated contest; close game; exciting battle
definitions.explanation: A competition in which both sides are evenly matched and give their all, creating an exciting and closely fought contest, typically used in sports contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{両|りょう}→両：11182_ryou⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{熱戦|ねっせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{繰|く}り{広|ひろ}げられた→繰り広げる：06982_kurihirogeru⟧。
examples.english: A fierce match unfolded between the two teams.

examples.japanese: ⟦{決勝|けっしょう}→決勝：04742_kesshou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{汗|あせ}→汗：02173_ase⟧⟦{握|にぎ}る→握る：02383_nigiru⟧{熱戦|ねっせん}だった。
examples.english: The final was an edge-of-your-seat heated contest.

examples.japanese: ⟦オリンピック→オリンピック：09899_orinpikku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{各国|かっこく}→各国：12055_kakkoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{熱戦|ねっせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{繰|く}り{広|ひろ}げ→繰り広げる：06982_kurihirogeru⟧、⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}いに→大いに：01609_ooini⟧⟦{盛|も}り{上|あ}がった→盛り上がる：06344_moriagaru⟧。
examples.english: Athletes from various countries fought fierce contests at the Olympics, and the venue was buzzing with excitement.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{熱|ねつ}→熱：01690_netsu⟧ (heat, passion) and ⟦{戦|せん}→〜戦：28346_sen⟧ (battle, match), describing a contest that is exciting, closely fought, and full of passionate effort from both sides. Primarily used in sports and competitive contexts.

USAGE:
- Most commonly appears in sports reporting and commentary
- Implies both sides are evenly matched and giving their all
- {熱戦|ねっせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{繰|く}り{広|ひろ}げる→繰り広げる：06982_kurihirogeru⟧ is the most characteristic collocation

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {熱戦|ねっせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{繰|く}り{広|ひろ}げる→繰り広げる：06982_kurihirogeru⟧: to fight a fierce match
- ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{汗|あせ}→汗：02173_ase⟧⟦{握|にぎ}る→握る：02383_nigiru⟧{熱戦|ねっせん}: a nail-biting contest
- {熱戦|ねっせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{末|すえ}→末：03362_sue⟧: after a fierce battle
- {熱戦|ねっせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{展開|てんかい}される→展開する：25229_tenkaisuru⟧: a heated contest unfolds

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{激戦|げきせん}→激戦：13415_gekisen⟧: fierce battle — can be used for actual warfare as well as sports; emphasizes intensity
- ⟦{接戦|せっせん}→接戦：08176_sessen⟧: close game — emphasizes the narrow margin rather than the excitement
- {好{勝負|しょうぶ}: good match — similar meaning but focuses on the quality of competition
- {死闘|しとう}: fight to the death — much more dramatic and extreme
